questiontext.text: Which of the following are primary economic reasons for rearing farm animals in Nigeria? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Livestock provides food, farm income, employment, and industrial raw materials. Destroying forests is not an objective.

questiontext.text: Match each type of farm animal with its primary operational category:

generalfeedback.text: Bullocks provide draught labor; White Fulani cows produce milk; broilers supply meat; and catfish are farmed aquatic animals.
